primary_next_protocol.authority: Root selected audit_evidence's controlled fresh-process A1/A2 then conditional paired-history B ordering
sequence: A1: fresh process, same bound float32 latent bytes, scale1024, full geometry, native math, identical checkpoint source, one scaled backward; retain complete evidence before verdict
A2: second fresh process with exactly A1's configuration; retain complete evidence before verdict
Compare actual saved A1/A2 gradient arrays on CPU. Only if exact, run B with unscaled retained-graph backward, clear latent.grad, then scaled backward on that same graph
If A1/A2 differ, stop before B and investigate the scaled-single path's own repeatability; do not attribute g/h solely to retained-graph history
primary_next_protocol.alternative_same_graph_scaled_scaled_con: A same-graph scaled/scaled repetition may be informative later, but is not added to or substituted for the selected A1/A2->B budget.

facts: Forward bitwise equality is explicitly recorded
Unscaled input gradient was all zero
Scaled-after-unscaled raw gradient had 262060 finite nonzero elements
36 blocks across three temporal chunks gave 108 checkpoint forward calls and 216 recomputations over two backwards
Two forwards and one backward returned
Scaled-single raw gradient had 262052 finite nonzero elements
After-backward frozen fingerprint was not reached
h_failure.source_based_inference_only: Reaching the backward establishes that the source's forward allclose guard returned; failure.json does not contain its actual values or bitwise result.

observed_g_h_boundary.statistics_limit: The 1.4901161193847656e-08 difference between reported unscaled max-absolute statistics is not max(abs(gradient_h-gradient_g)). Likewise, eight fewer nonzero elements is not a count or location map of all changed coordinates. Complete arrays were not saved, so actual Linf, relative L2, cosine, signs and support changes remain unknown.

source_confirmed_findings.finding: The paired path clears leaf accumulation before its second backward
source_confirmed_findings.evidence: check_vae_decode_grad.py h lines173-176: latent.grad=None before scaled backward; the actual g/h source diff confirms this paired branch is unchanged
source_confirmed_findings.implication: Direct addition of the first leaf gradient to the second is not an explanation. This does not establish that the rest of the retained graph/native execution state is identical to a fresh graph.

source_confirmed_findings.finding: g and h use the same decoder checkpoint implementation
source_confirmed_findings.actual_diff_review: h adds --loss-scale, corresponding contract fields, first_loss multiplication, diagnostic naming and common FP32 unscale logic. No VAE temporal-layout or checkpoint wrapper change appears in that diff.
source_confirmed_findings.implication: There is no source evidence for an accidental change in temporal chunk/checkpoint structure. The intentional number/history of backwards differs.

source_confirmed_findings.finding: Native VAE attention follows the PyTorch SDPA route under the default inspected Ascend configuration
source_confirmed_findings.evidence: model_management.py462-475 enables PyTorch attention for Ascend unless split/quad options are set; attention.py591-632 uses comfy.ops.scaled_dot_product_attention with dropout_p=0 and is_causal=False; ops.py58-63 forwards to torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention
source_confirmed_findings.limit: The package exposes native scaled_dot_product_attention and fusion-attention symbols, but their dispatch implementation/profiling trace was not available in the inspected source. This review does not assert which concrete fused backward kernel ran, or that it is nondeterministic.

source_confirmed_findings.finding: The native RoPE replacement is shared and uses explicit NPU RMS/rotary primitives
source_confirmed_findings.evidence: ascend/rope.py _rms_rope1 calls torch_npu.npu_rms_norm and _apply_rope1 calls npu_rotary_mul; check_vae_decode_grad.decoder_math scopes the same functional replacement across both forwards/backwards
source_confirmed_findings.limit: No per-call deterministic option appears in these inspected Python functions. That absence does not establish nondeterminism, and no backward kernel internals were inspected.

source_confirmed_findings.finding: Temporal decode creates several contributions to shared latent positions
source_confirmed_findings.evidence: vae.py729-789 pads by repeated last latent tokens, slices overlapping clips, blends overlap, and copies finalized chunks into the output; checkpoint wraps36 transformer blocks without changing these operations
source_confirmed_findings.implication: Reduction/accumulation order and FP16 quantization are candidate mechanisms to diagnose, alongside attention/RMS/rotary backward. They are not identified causes.

source_confirmed_findings.finding: There is an explicit FP16 gradient boundary
source_confirmed_findings.evidence: check_vae_decode_grad.py153-155 creates an FP32 leaf then passes latent.to(dtype=vae.vae_dtype) into the FP16 VAE; CPU FP32 unscale happens only after backward
source_confirmed_findings.observation: Both g and h report raw minimum nonzero magnitude5.960464477539063e-08, consistent with an FP16 subnormal step. Dividing by1024 yields5.820766091346741e-11.
source_confirmed_findings.limit: This is consistent with gradient quantization and explains why tiny value changes could alter zero counts; it does not locate the earlier source of a difference or prove a harmless error bound.

set_deterministic_level.observed_behavior: Synchronizes torch's deterministic-algorithms flag with level0 or level>=1, then calls _C._npu_set_deterministic_level(level)
set_deterministic_level.explicit_source_warning: After using torch_npu.npu.set_deterministic_level, do not use torch.use_deterministic_algorithms again; source warns of unknown errors from mixing them
set_deterministic_level.limit: Python source does not enumerate complete supported level semantics or guarantee every native VAE operation has a deterministic implementation. No level was changed or tested here.

npu_deterministic_getter_caution.finding: _get_deterministic_level is not a pure observer: when global Torch and NPU levels disagree it calls set_deterministic_level and mutates state
npu_deterministic_getter_caution.recommendation: Do not call this reconciling getter merely as untracked logging. Record Torch flags directly; if the native level is inspected via a nonmutating native getter, label that private API and pin its runtime.

autograd_boundary_helpers.finding: enable_deterministic_with_backward and disable_deterministic_with_backward insert custom autograd functions that toggle global Torch deterministic state in both forward and backward
autograd_boundary_helpers.recommendation: Do not insert these graph/global-state changes into the first repeatability control. Checkpoint/recompute interactions would become another changed factor.

native_op_api_bridge.finding: Captures at::globalContext().deterministicAlgorithms(), includes it in the op API cache/dispatch state, and passes it to at_npu::native::SetDeterministicOps
native_op_api_bridge.implication: A real backend control path exists; source still does not prove coverage or determinism of the actual dispatched VAE backward kernels.

local_determinism_interfaces.next_control_policy: First A1/A2 preserve the exact existing numerical configuration and record actual deterministic flags before/after forward/backward. If nonrepeatability remains, a separately declared one-factor deterministic-mode experiment may follow; do not silently toggle settings, combine APIs, tolerate unsupported-op failures, or relax the strict acceptance gate.

required_evidence_before_any_verdict: Same serialized float32 latent bytes or matching freshly calculated SHA, shape, dtype and source-generation recipe
Input and output numerical parity values, exact output SHA/equality and model/runtime metadata
Before and after frozen-parameter SHA/version/grad checks, including on gradient comparison failure
Actual CPU float32 gradient arrays after every relevant backward, both raw-scaled and FP32-unscaled or a strictly verified reconstructible relation, each with file/array SHA
Actual checkpoint scope restoration and recompute counts, actual deterministic settings, HF32/JIT/precision/backend environment
CPU exact equality, true elementwise Linf/relative L2/cosine, sign changes and zero-support intersections; report descriptive errors without inventing a new passing tolerance
Atomic complete observation receipt before final gate decision, so a failed SHA verdict does not erase frozen/forward evidence
conclusion: No source-confirmed causal bug or established kernel nondeterminism explains g versus h yet. Same helper/source math and explicit leaf-grad reset narrow the questions; fresh-process scaled-single repeatability with complete arrays is the selected next control. The strict failed gate remains failed.
